_doc: Phase G.12 (Growth) — A/B experiment registry. src/worker.js HTMLRewriter reads this file, computes a per-visitor bucket (SHA256(sub || YYYY-MM) for signed-in; SHA256(IP || UA || YYYY-MM-DD) for anonymous), and stamps <html data-experiment='X' data-treatment='Y'> on the response. CSS swaps via [data-treatment='warmer'] selectors. Each experiment fires 'Experiment Exposure' once per session per experiment (deduped via sessionStorage in first-touch.js). Bucketing rule: first two hex chars of the SHA256 → mod 100 → bucket. Promote a treatment by editing this file: status='promoted', then drop the data-treatment selectors after the next deploy.
